Messages.Author: henrik isaksson
Messages.Body:
If a player has tapped sunset strip during his turn, and then is ousted
before his next, do all vampires always have +1 stealth for the rest of the
game?

/henrik isaksson

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
henrik isaksson wrote:

> If a player has tapped sunset strip during his turn, and then is ousted
> before his next, do all vampires always have +1 stealth for the rest of the
> game?

Yes.

(I would've thought that the +1 stealth would go away when the card did,
but LSJ's ruling on turbo-Annabelle indicates I would've been wrong.)

--Colin McGuigan
